verses.text: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
lines: “Surely there is a mine for silver,
and a place for gold which they refine.

verses.text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
lines: Iron is taken out of the earth,
and copper is smelted out of the ore.

verses.text: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
lines: Man sets an end to darkness,
and searches out, to the furthest bound,
the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

verses.text: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
lines: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live.
They are forgotten by the foot.
They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

verses.text: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
lines: As for the earth, out of it comes bread;
Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

verses.text: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
lines: Sapphires come from its rocks.
It has dust of gold.

verses.text: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
lines: That path no bird of prey knows,
neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

verses.text: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
lines: The proud animals have not trodden it,
nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

verses.text: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
lines: He puts his hand on the flinty rock,
and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

verses.text: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
lines: He cuts out channels among the rocks.
His eye sees every precious thing.

verses.text: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
lines: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle.
The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

verses.text: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
lines: “But where will wisdom be found?
Where is the place of understanding?

verses.text: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
lines: Man doesn’t know its price;
Neither is it found in the land of the living.

verses.text: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
lines: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’
The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

verses.text: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
lines: It can’t be gotten for gold,
neither will silver be weighed for its price.

verses.text: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
lines: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir,
with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

verses.text: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
lines: Gold and glass can’t equal it,
neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

verses.text: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
lines: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal.
Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

verses.text: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it, nor will it be valued with pure gold.
lines: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it,
nor will it be valued with pure gold.

verses.text: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
lines: Where then does wisdom come from?
Where is the place of understanding?

verses.text: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
lines: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living,
and kept close from the birds of the sky.

verses.text: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
lines: Destruction and Death say,
‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

verses.text: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
lines: “God understands its way,
and he knows its place.

verses.text: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
lines: For he looks to the ends of the earth,
and sees under the whole sky.

verses.text: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
lines: He establishes the force of the wind.
Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

verses.text: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
lines: When he made a decree for the rain,
and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

verses.text: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
lines: then he saw it, and declared it.
He established it, yes, and searched it out.

verses.text: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
lines: To man he said,
‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom.
To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
